name: Inverform twin-wire board forming
summary: A way of making multi-layer paperboard in which an extra upside-down wire draws water out of each new pulp layer, letting heavier boards be made faster.
description: Continuous multi-ply board forming with an additional inverted wire that draws water upward from newly added pulp layers rather than through the earlier plies.
